profile.headline: Real Time Software Engineer at Boeing | Robotics Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm driven by a desire to understand the world. To be able to take it apart, comprehend it, and put it back together piece by piece. The desire started with legos, led me to study biology, and now sees me applying expertise in robotics and software design.   

Programming Languages: C/C++/C#, Python, Java

Tools: Robot Operating System (ROS), OnShape, SolidWorks, Matlab, Git, Github, Milling, Lathe, Version Control, Mathematica, Eagle PCB

Methodologies: Sensor Fusion, Computer Numerical Control (CNC), Feedback Control Systems, PIDs, Motor Control

Hardware: Arduino, Microchip PIC, Microcontrollers, Electronics

positions.title: Real Time Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Analysis, Design, and Implementation for time-sensitive systems such as simulators and diagnostic programs.

positions.title: Precision Filer
positions.description:
Filing and grinding material to finish machined aerospace parts.
Evaluating processes for potential automation.

positions.title: Laboratory Technician II
positions.description: Senior technician in Sanger Sequencing Core. Responsible for sample processing and data analysis, customer service, and general lab maintenance in concert with a small team of other technicians. Also take responsibility for maintaining most reagent and supply stocks, upkeep and digitization of protocol library, troubleshooting of technical issues with machinery, and liasoning with technical support when necessary to resolve equipment issues.

positions.title: Laboratory Assistant
positions.description: Responsible for sanitization, waste disposal, and class prep. Also took full inventory of stock room resources and made reference/training manuals.

volunteerExperiences.description: I run online sessions with students taking the C++ training course to help them with concepts and execution.
